decisions.briefing: Markets dipped slightly today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, which counts as a neutral day rather than a selloff. We have $645 in cash and 3 open slots, so we're putting the cash into one medium-conviction buy of RH, which shows every buy signal we look for. All seven current positions stay open, and their automatic stop-loss and profit-target levels remain in place.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%. No news headlines were provided today, so no specific cause can be cited. A move this small is often normal profit-taking or lighter trading around a holiday rather than a change in direction, and many individual stocks still showed bullish signals.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回落，納斯達克指數跌0.6%，標普500指數跌0.3%。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，無法指出具體的觸發因素。如此輕微的波動多屬正常的獲利回吐或假期前後交投淡靜，未必代表趨勢逆轉；事實上，不少個股的技術指標仍然偏強。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Volume confirmation means checking that a price move happened on higher-than-usual trading volume, which suggests big investors are behind it rather than a few random trades. Today RH's rise came with volume more than 1.5 times its 20-day average, and the other bullish signals agreed. That is why it was picked over candidates whose signals looked similar but had no volume surge.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「成交量確認」是指股價上升的同時，成交量亦明顯高於平日，顯示升勢背後有大型機構資金參與，而非零星買盤推動。今日RH的升幅伴隨成交量達20日平均的1.5倍以上，加上其他技術指標同樣向好，因此在一眾指標相近但欠缺量能配合的候選股中脫穎而出。
